goal.en: Give Mia sincere compliments, and accept one gracefully.
goal.zh: 真誠地稱讚米亞，也大方地接受她的稱讚。

background: small shared apartment kitchen in the evening, wooden table set with two plates of creamy pasta, a pot on the stove, warm pendant lights, herbs growing on the windowsill

intro.en: Friday evening. You come home and smell garlic. Mia is cooking dinner for both of you.
intro.zh: 星期五晚上。你一回家就聞到蒜香，米亞正在煮兩人份的晚餐。

intro.en: Something about Mia looks different today. She keeps touching her hair.
intro.zh: 今天的米亞看起來哪裡不太一樣，她一直摸自己的頭髮。

lines.en: Hey, Kai! So... do you notice anything different?
lines.zh: 嘿，凱！那個……你有沒有發現哪裡不一樣？

choices.en: You got a haircut! I love your new hair.
choices.zh: 你剪頭髮了！我好喜歡你的新髮型。
choices.tip: 注意到對方的改變，再用 I love your... 稱讚，對方會很開心。

choices.en: Wow, you cut your hair! I very like it.
choices.zh: 哇，你剪頭髮了！我很喜歡。

lines.en: You... very like it? So do you like it or not?
lines.zh: 你……很喜歡它？所以你到底喜不喜歡？

story.en: Mia asks three more times if you really like it. You say yes three more times.
story.zh: 米亞又問了三次你是不是真的喜歡，你也回答了三次「是」。

fail.why: 「我很喜歡」不能直翻成 I very like it，very 不能直接修飾動詞。要說 I really like it. 或 I love it.。

choices.en: New haircut! Your face looks rounder.
choices.zh: 新髮型！你的臉看起來比較圓。

lines.en: Rounder? Wow. Thanks a lot, Kai.
lines.zh: 比較圓？哇，真是謝謝你喔，凱。

story.en: Mia wears her hoodie with the hood up for the rest of the evening.
story.zh: 整個晚上，米亞都把帽 T 的帽子戴得好好的。

fail.why: 台灣長輩常直接評論外表，像是「變胖了」「臉變圓了」，但在英語文化裡評論身材或臉型很失禮。稱讚就只說好的部分。

lines.en: Really? I was so nervous. It's a lot shorter than before.
lines.zh: 真的嗎？我超緊張的，比之前短很多。

choices.en: It looks great on you. I mean it!
choices.tip: look great on + 人，是稱讚髮型、衣服「很適合某人」的固定說法。

choices.en: It looks great to you. Really!

lines.en: To me? Wait, I'm asking what YOU think!
lines.zh: 我覺得？等等，我是在問你覺得怎樣耶！

story.en: Mia goes to the mirror and asks it instead. The mirror doesn't answer either.
story.zh: 米亞跑去問鏡子，鏡子也沒回答她。

fail.why: look great on someone 是「某人穿戴起來很好看」；looks great to you 意思變成「在你看來很好看」，主詞整個搞反了。

story.en: Mia spends the next hour looking up hair clips to hide it.
story.zh: 米亞接下來一小時都在上網找能遮住短髮的髮夾。

fail.why: 對方說自己很緊張時，只重複事實 It's short. 聽起來像在批評。要給明確的正面回饋：It looks great on you!

lines.en: Aw, thanks! Okay, dinner's ready. I made pasta!
lines.zh: 哇，謝謝！好了，晚餐煮好了，我做了義大利麵！

lines.en: You take a bite. It's creamy, garlicky, and delicious.
lines.zh: 你吃了一口，濃郁、蒜香十足，非常好吃。

choices.en: This is so good! You're a great cook.
choices.zh: 這個超好吃！你很會煮菜。
choices.tip: 稱讚廚藝說 You're a great cook!，cook 當名詞就是「廚師、會做菜的人」。

choices.en: Very delicious! You are a good cooker.
choices.zh: 非常好吃！你是很好的廚師。

lines.en: A cooker? Like a rice cooker?

story.en: Mia laughs so hard she drops her fork. Now she signs every text "Mia the Rice Cooker."
story.zh: 米亞笑到叉子都掉了。現在她傳訊息都署名「電鍋米亞」。

fail.why: 「廚師」不是 cooker，cooker 是鍋子、爐具，像 rice cooker 就是電鍋。會做菜的人叫 cook：You're a great cook!

choices.en: It's pasta with cream and garlic.
choices.zh: 這是奶油蒜味義大利麵。

lines.en: Yes, I know. I made it. But do you LIKE it?
lines.zh: 對，我知道，是我做的。但你喜歡嗎？

story.en: Mia waits for your review. You describe the noodles, the sauce, and the plate.
story.zh: 米亞等你給評價，你卻描述了麵條、醬汁，還有盤子。

fail.why: 對方煮飯給你吃，問 How is it? 是想知道你的感想，不是要你介紹菜色。先說 This is so good!

lines.en: Thanks! And hey, your English is getting really good, Kai.
lines.zh: 謝啦！對了，凱，你的英文越來越好了耶。

choices.en: Thank you! That means a lot.
choices.zh: 謝謝你！這句話對我意義重大。
choices.tip: 被稱讚時大方說 Thank you!，再加 That means a lot. 表示你很珍惜。

choices.en: No, no, my English is very bad.
choices.zh: 沒有啦沒有啦，我的英文很爛。

lines.en: Very bad? But we're talking in English right now!
lines.zh: 很爛？可是我們現在就在用英文聊天啊！

story.en: Mia spends ten minutes trying to convince you. You both forget to finish the pasta.
story.zh: 米亞花了十分鐘想說服你，你們都忘了把麵吃完。

fail.why: 台灣習慣用「沒有啦」謙虛回應稱讚，但在英語文化裡一直否認，對方會覺得自己說錯話。大方說 Thank you! 就好。

choices.en: Thank you! I am practice every day.

lines.en: You ARE practice? Hmm, maybe practice a little more!
lines.zh: 你「是」練習？嗯，也許要再多練一點喔！

story.en: Mia sticks a grammar note on the fridge for you. It says "I practice." in big letters.
story.zh: 米亞在冰箱上貼了一張文法便條給你，上面大大寫著「I practice.」。

fail.why: 說習慣用現在簡單式：I practice every day.。am 和原形動詞不能放在一起，要說正在進行可以用 I'm practicing.。

lines.en: See? That's the perfect answer. Now, more pasta?
lines.zh: 看吧？這就是最完美的回答。好啦，再來一點麵？

lines.en: You hold out your plate with a big smile.
lines.zh: 你笑著把盤子遞了過去。

story.en: You and Mia trade compliments all evening. She makes you promise to cook Taiwanese food next week.
story.zh: 你和米亞互相稱讚了一整晚，她還要你答應下週煮台灣菜給她吃。

notes.explain: 注意到朋友的改變並說出來，是很自然的稱讚。I love your... 可以接衣服、鞋子、包包等。
look great on + 人，用來稱讚髮型、衣服穿戴在某人身上很好看。注意介系詞是 on，不是 to。

example.en: That jacket looks great on you.

notes.explain: cook 當名詞是「會做菜的人」，cooker 是鍋子或爐具，例如 rice cooker（電鍋）、pressure cooker（壓力鍋）。

example.en: My dad is a great cook.

notes.explain: 中文習慣用「沒有啦」「還好啦」謙虛回應，但英語文化中大方接受稱讚才是禮貌，一直否認反而讓對方尷尬。

example.en: Thank you! That means a lot.
example.zh: 謝謝你！這句話對我意義重大。

notes.zh: 我很喜歡（不是 I very like it）。
notes.explain: very 只能修飾形容詞或副詞，不能直接修飾動詞。「很喜歡」要說 I really like it.、I like it a lot. 或 I love it.。
